title: sealedstack stack.yaml
description: Slot selection and global settings (spec section 5.1).

name.description: Infra repo name; namespaces the remote state key (sealedstack/<name>/<stack>.tfstate, spec §6.3a).

admin_user.description: The Linux admin user created on every server.

providers.description: Per-implementation non-secret config, keyed by '<slot>_<impl>' (e.g. backup_s3, gate_authentik).

backup.description: Backup destination settings for the selected backup slot.

secondary.description: Optional second, off-provider copy of every backup (the 3-2-1 rule). The platform stack creates a second Dokploy destination and a second backup schedule for each database when this is set.

mesh.description: Mesh settings. Your own tailnet policy lives in config/tailscale-policy.hujson (imported by `init`); sealedstack merges only its block into it (D-026).

tailnet.description: MagicDNS suffix, e.g. tail1234.ts.net, for fully-qualified hostnames (required when slots.mesh is tailscale).

policy.description: 'managed' (default): sealedstack merges its tags, rules and tests into config/tailscale-policy.hujson and applies the result. 'unmanaged': sealedstack prints its block for manual pasting and leaves the tailnet policy alone.

narrow_allow_all.description: F1: when true and the tailnet policy still has the default allow-all rule, sealedstack rewrites the exact `* -> *` rule to `autogroup:member -> autogroup:member:*` (members' own devices only) so tagged servers are excluded. When false, a broad rule makes plan/apply refuse with instructions.

team_name.description: Zero Trust team name; the Access login is <team_name>.cloudflareaccess.com.

public_hostnames.description: Hostnames under the domain that are served outside sealedstack (for example a vendor's CNAME such as clerk.<domain>) and must not be denied by the catch-all: each gets a Bypass Access app.

min_tls_version.description: Lowest TLS version the Cloudflare zone accepts (D-079).

restrict_tls_ciphers.description: Offer only AEAD (GCM/ChaCha20) ECDHE suites; drops CBC-SHA. Needs Cloudflare Advanced Certificate Manager (paid), so it is off by default (D-079).

security_headers.description: Set Permissions-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy on every app hostname (D-078).

prefix.description: Namespace of this infra's objects in the state bucket (sealedstack/<prefix>/...). Defaults to `name`; set it to keep existing state when the infra repo is renamed.

git_provider.description: Dokploy Git provider for building repo apps in `server` build mode (spec 4.4).

secrets.description: Secret key mapping (D-050): each logical secret -> its key in the source. Omitted entries default to the upper-cased logical name.

project.description: Source project/namespace for infra secrets (e.g. the Bitwarden project). Default: infra.

app_project.description: Source project that holds app secrets (`<app>.<NAME>` keys). Default: prod.

approvers.description: GitHub usernames allowed to approve write commands in CI (D-052). Required when slots.ci is set.

admin.description: Admin identity. SSH public keys (not secrets) are installed during bootstrap (D-040); no keys are accepted from the environment.

ssh_keys.description: Operator SSH public keys to trust on every server.

drill.description: Restore drills (D-084, D-085): a rehearsal of restoring the newest database backup.

scheduled.description: Run the drill on the weekly cron of the workflow. Off by default: drills then run only when asked.

level.description: How much a drill restores: verify < schema < sample < tables < full.

min_free_ratio.description: Data levels need this many times the live database size free on the server, else they are skipped.

where.description: Where the throwaway Postgres runs. `server`: on the app's server, the backup streams from R2 straight to it. `runner`: structure only (levels verify and schema), only the DDL text reaches the machine the engine runs on.

max_backup_age.description: Warn when the newest backup is older than this (90s, 30m, 2h, 48h).

limits.description: Resource limits of a drill; a preflight that does not fit skips the drill instead of failing it.

memory.description: Memory limit of the throwaway Postgres container (the host needs twice this available).

cpus.description: CPU limit of the throwaway container.

timeout.description: Overall deadline of a drill; leftovers older than this are removed.

max_load.description: Skip when the server's 1-minute load per core is above this.

allow_image_pull.description: Let the server pull the Postgres image when it is not present.

slot_impl.description: Name of the implementation chosen for this slot (spec section 4).
